The challenge input contract is: Return minima for inclusive ranges [0,3], [2,5], [4,6], in that order; input contains at least seven integers. Those bounded tests establish these examples; they are not a proof for all inputs or a measurement on an iPhone.

Whole-number medians have no decimal suffix; half medians use .5. Do not append a newline to the returned value. Preserve the explicitly named textual sentinels such as none or #.
